newsitem.title: USA: Choice Hotels stake raised by Baron.
newsitem.headline: Choice Hotels stake raised by Baron.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Thursday he raised his stake in Choice Hotels International Inc to 10,827,908 common shares or 17.2 percent from 15 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said his latest transactions include the purchase of 596,200 common shares between January 21 and February 27 at prices ranging from $15.125 to $16.5281 per share.
Choice Hotels is an international lodging company based in Silver Spring, Md.
